summary: Verified the sequence-timing rework end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_sequence_timing.py — new FlowInput fields (durations[], playouts[], repeat, repeatEvery, intro/transition/outro) round-trip via POST/GET/PUT /api/flows; overlay HTML /api/public/scene/{token}/overlay returns 200 and embeds the new client cycler (buildSteps, durFor, waitMediaEnd, playoutFor) and the flow durations (300s for the Timing Test flow); the old everyX schedule leak check 'setIdx' is absent. A freshly-created scene with a 2-overlay durations=[4,4] loop flow also serves overlay HTML with the new cycler. Regression: /overlays, /flows, /scenes, and scene public overlay endpoints all 200. Frontend (Playwright, admin + MFA): sequence editor (/sequences/93794d1f…) exposes flow-repeat-field (loop/once/interval), flow-repeatevery (shows when 'interval', hides when 'loop'), flow-intro, flow-transition, flow-outro, and per-item seq-playout-i / seq-dur-i-val / seq-dur-i-unit for every row; Play out toggle disables the duration input; min-unit value 5 persists as 300s backend-side and still renders '5 min' after reload. Scene editor (/scenes/e2c39a24…) for a placed Overlay sequence shows the new flow-timing-hint + flow-edit-timing link; the old 'Appear every / Show for / When to show / everyMinutes' fields are gone. Flows list card shows the repeat text ('repeat every 5m' etc.) instead of '5s each'. Timing bug sanity: overlay HTML contains buildSteps/durFor/waitMediaEnd and no setIdx — the chop-after-20s path is removed.

issues: When a flow already has an intro/transition/outro object pointing to an overlayId that is NOT in the current html-assets list (e.g. the Timing Test flow references a non-existent/non-html asset), the Select shows 'None' while the 'Show for … sec' field still renders — gives a confusing mixed state. Cosmetic/UX only; backend keeps the value. Consider showing an inline warning ('Linked asset not found — pick again') or auto-clearing when the asset disappears.

critical_code_review_comments: FlowInput still carries legacy `loop` for back-compat but create_flow/update_flow force it to True whenever it is None — if a client sends {loop:false, repeat:'loop'} the two can disagree. Only `repeat` is now used by the overlay generator, so consider dropping the legacy field or deriving it from `repeat` to avoid drift.

FlowEditor save() always sends intro/transition/outro as `flow.intro || null` — selecting then deselecting (choosing 'None') correctly posts null, but if the user never touches the field it still echoes whatever the server loaded, which is fine. No action, just noting.

SceneEditor.addFlow() still seeds `schedule: { mode:'always', everyMinutes:5, showSeconds:20 }` even though the overlay generator ignores it now. Harmless but dead data — consider removing to keep the scene document clean.
seed_data_creation: Transient test data created inside TestTimingSanity (2 TEST_P* pancartes, 1 TEST_SanityFlow flow, 1 TEST_SanityScene scene) and 1 TEST_Timing_Flow in TestFlowTimingFields — all deleted at the end of each test class. Timing Test flow (93794d1f-4b3c-40f1-9cdf-d3b5492ea439) was re-saved from the UI (same values: item0=5min timed, item1=10s play-out, repeat=interval every 5m).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rework is production-green. The overlay cycler lives entirely in the overlay HTML via buildSteps()/play()/restartPart()/waitMediaEnd(); durFor uses flow.durations[pos] with flow.interval fallback; playoutFor waits for a <video> 'ended' event with a safety fallback. Scene flow placements still carry an unused `schedule` object — don't rely on it. Flow fields that persist: durations[], playouts[], repeat ('loop'|'once'|'interval'), repeatEvery (minutes), intro/transition/outro ({overlayId,url,kind,fit,seconds}|null). Sequence editor testids: flow-repeat-field, flow-repeatevery, flow-intro, flow-transition, flow-outro, flow-intro-sec/flow-transition-sec/flow-outro-sec, seq-playout-{i}, seq-dur-{i}-val, seq-dur-{i}-unit. Scene editor flow-panel testids: flow-select, flow-enabled-toggle, flow-timing-hint, flow-edit-timing, flow-pancarte-toggle-{pid}.
rca of the issue: N/A — the originally reported 'overlay repeats after a few seconds / never plays out' bug was fixed before this iteration by moving all timing onto the sequence (durations[] + playouts[] + repeat) and rewriting the overlay HTML to a per-placement state machine (buildSteps/play/onEnd/start). This test iteration independently verified: (a) the new flow fields round-trip through the API, (b) the overlay HTML embeds them and ships the new helpers, (c) the old everyX/setIdx/showSeconds chop path is no longer generated, and (d) the UI exposes the new per-item unit toggle and intro/transition/outro pickers with full data-testid coverage and save-reload persistence.
